description: Investigation Team members (and Shadows) who appear in Vincent's nightmares. Portraits and voices come from the player's Persona 4 Golden install. bustup_glob matches portrait files inside the CPKs; expression N in dialogue is the Nth match in name order.

rows.name: Yu Narukami
rows._notes: P4G gives the protagonist no dialogue portrait (no bustup/b1_*), so Yu speaks with his name plate only, as in P4G. His cut-in is Izanagi's card (card/persona/i_prc001.tmx, confirmed by the player).

rows.name: Yosuke Hanamura
rows._notes: b2 confirmed as Yosuke by the player (char_02.png). Expressions 1-9, frame 1. Cut-in: his Persona-summon texture (SYKN = summon, 2 = Yosuke's party slot); what it shows is unconfirmed, and there's no Jiraiya card in card/persona (those are the protagonist's Personas).

rows.name: Chie Satonaka
rows._notes: b3 confirmed as Chie by the player (char_03.png).

rows.name: Teddie
rows._notes: b8 confirmed as Teddie by the player (char_08.png). His files use frame 0 (b8_1_0..b8_7_0).

rows.name: Shadow Yosuke
rows._notes: P4G has no Shadow Yosuke portrait (the player checked every b2 file: all normal Yosuke), so the mod shows Yosuke's real portrait with a Shadow treatment: darkened, gold-tinted, with a glowing gold rim.
